subject: ISL staffing + leaderboard scope
body: Dmitri — staffing and scope. Core: Csilla 50% (ISL modeling), Linnea 40% (partner-dataset evaluation), Rafael 30% through June (self-supervised setting). The addition we agreed: adoption needs a visible comparison surface — there's no internal service for this, so we're scoping and staffing a benchmark leaderboard service from scratch for structure-learning evals: run submission, SHD and edge-F1 rankings per dataset, and per-environment breakdowns. Jorge owns it at 60%. Compute: negligible (CPU plus occasional titan GPUs). Dependencies: partner tabular data goes through Corpus, and their schema intake pauses for the v2 migration freeze on 2026-07-10 — Linnea's ingestion request is filed this week to stay ahead of it. Privacy review for the partner dataset started Monday; the 2-3 week SLA fits if nothing bounces. — Alina
